basic.seoTitle: GlobeGuard BASIC – Diagnostic device for your brand
basic.seoDescription: GlobeGuard BASIC: OBD diagnostics for 1 brand group from model year 2008 – for car & van, motorcycle or as a WoMo set with Truma support.
basic.title: Configure GlobeGuard BASIC
basic.subtitle: Diagnostics for 1 brand group from model year 2008. Choose vehicle type, brand and model year – we will show you the right device.
basic.womoText: The GlobeGuard BASIC WoMo combines 1 car/van brand group with additional Truma diagnostics – ideal for motorhomes.

pro.seoTitle: GlobeGuard PRO – up to 3 brand groups on one device
pro.seoDescription: GlobeGuard PRO: Workshop-grade OBD diagnostics from model year 1991. Up to 3 brand groups per device, expandable via PRO Extension – for car & van, motorcycle, truck/bus/trailer, agricultural and industrial vehicles.
pro.title: Configure GlobeGuard PRO
pro.subtitle: Diagnostics from model year 1991, up to 3 brand groups on one device. The first brand is included in the price; additional brands are charged as PRO Extension.

womo.seoTitle: GlobeGuard WoMo – Diagnostic device for your motorhome
womo.seoDescription: GlobeGuard WoMo: Diagnostics for 1 base-vehicle brand group from model year 2008 plus additional Truma diagnostics. Heater locked? Unlock it yourself.
womo.title: Configure GlobeGuard WoMo
womo.subtitle: The WoMo set combines diagnostics for your base vehicle (1 brand group, from model year 2008) with the additional Truma module – so you can unlock locked heaters yourself. Choose the brand of your base vehicle and the model year.
womo.hintText: For Truma diagnostics you also need the adapter cable set for Truma Combi 4 / 6 / D (<price>CHF 90.00</price>) – we suggest it automatically on the product page.
womo.notWomo: Not a motorhome? The regular <link>GlobeGuard BASIC</link> is available for car & van or motorcycle <price>from CHF 583.00</price>.

elite.seoTitle: GlobeGuard ELITE – Multibrand Diagnostics for Workshops
elite.seoDescription: GlobeGuard ELITE: Multibrand OBD diagnostics for professional use. Cars Mixed 4–10, Cars/Moto/Bus/Truck-Trailer Multibrand and ELITE Full across all classes.
elite.title: GlobeGuard ELITE
elite.subtitle: Multibrand diagnostics without brand limits – choose the vehicle class of your business and we will show you the right device.
elite.busHint: Bus operators receive the ELITE Bus Multibrand – a dedicated device, separate from the Truck/Trailer Multibrand.

devices.carsMixed: 4–10 car/van brand groups of your choice – at least 4 at purchase, the rest at any later time.
devices.carsMultibrand: All car/van brand groups activated – full brand coverage for the car workshop.
devices.motoMultibrand: All motorcycle brand groups activated – one device for the entire motorcycle workshop.
devices.busMultibrand: All bus brand groups activated – the dedicated device for bus operators.
devices.truckMultibrand: All truck and trailer brand groups activated – incl. air-brake and tachograph functions.
devices.fullMultibrand: The flagship: all brand groups across all classes – car/van, truck, trailer and bus.
